limitations: This is a cross-revision characterization fixture from the same TLSNotary codebase and serializer family, not an independent implementation or an external normative golden vector.

The attestation UID and certificate-opening blinder are randomized, so rerunning the generator does not reproduce the exact Presentation bytes or SHA-256. The checked-in Presentation bytes are fixed and individually identified by their hash.

The packed-transcript bytes are captured from the clean upstream verifier output and compared against the patched Rust serializer. This cross-revision equality does not establish an approved FUSOU wire contract.
The test-only Notary verifying key is not a Production trust registration. The fixture is not a FUSOU require_info or Production evidence fixture.
